Prime Minister Narendra Modi's appeal for citizens to avoid non-essential gold purchases appears to have influenced this decline. October alone witnessed a substantial 62.57 percent drop in gold imports year on year. Additionally, the World Gold Council reported a significant reduction in overall gold demand.

items.title: Asia, Africa to drive expansion of India's export markets as shipments grow across regions
items.summary: India's merchandise exports have shown strong growth, particularly in Africa and Asia, according to recent government data. Exports to Africa increased by 44 percent, while shipments to Asia surpassed USD 100 billion. Engineering goods, electronic goods, and petroleum products have driven this expansion significantly. Notable growth was observed in markets such as Tanzania and Kenya in Africa.

items.title: The El Niño polycrisis: How a severe drought is squeezing Indian farms, ethanol plants and your kitchen budget
items.summary: El Niño is squeezing India’s farm economy as deficit rainfall drains reservoirs and stalls Rabi sowing. With water buffers shrinking and winter acreage trailing last year’s pace, food inflation risks are mounting—threatening household budgets.

items.title: MPCB asks Adani firm to stop excavation work for temporary labour shed in Satara
items.summary: Maharashtra Pollution Control Board issued a stop-work notice to Adani Renewable Energy One Ltd for unauthorized excavation. The notice pertains to a temporary labour camp related to a 1500 MW project in Satara district. The company commenced work without the necessary environmental clearance and approvals from the board. MPCB officials visited the site and proposed legal action following the unauthorised activities.

items.title: Aditya Birla Real Estate aims Rs 15,000 crore annual pre-sales in three years
items.summary: Aditya Birla Real Estate Ltd has set an ambitious target of achieving Rs 15,000 crore in annual pre-sales. The company recorded sales bookings of over Rs 8,000 crore during the past two financial years. Currently, it is focused on sustaining sales in ongoing projects while planning several upcoming launches. The company highlights significant growth potential in the Delhi-NCR market and plans to acquire additional land.

items.title: Johnnie Walker-owner overtakes Pernod Ricard as India's largest alco-bev firm; Radico Khaitan in 3rd place
items.summary: Pernod Ricard India reported a significant revenue decline of 13.6% in FY26, primarily due to the sale of Imperial Blue. Consequently, the company lost its status as the largest alcoholic beverage player to Diageo India. In contrast, Radico Khaitan experienced a strong performance with a nearly 22.7% increase in total income. The overall alco-bev market saw a combined revenue drop of over 5% in the same period.

items.title: Rising government debt unlikely to trigger broad sovereign crisis in 2027: UBS
items.summary: Government borrowing and debt-servicing costs are likely to escalate challenges for major economies by 2027. UBS reports that pressure stems from refinanced debt from low interest rates previously. Factors contributing to public finance pressure include ageing populations and entitlement spending. Measures like bond buybacks and changes in debt issuance strategies can help manage financing pressures. Nonetheless, UBS warns about potential difficulties that could lead to a debt crisis.

items.title: Grid constraints, slower project awards may weigh on solar capacity growth beyond FY28: Report
items.summary: India's solar capacity additions have increased significantly, reaching 44.61 GW in FY26, with continued momentum in FY27. Rooftop solar initiatives, alongside agricultural programs, have bolstered demand, particularly under the PM Surya Ghar scheme. However, there has been a noticeable slowdown in new renewable energy project awards, raising concerns about future expansion. Transmission challenges are also affecting grid performance, notably in Rajasthan and Gujarat.

items.title: Non-coal mining projects spread up to 500 hectares now to be appraised at state level
items.summary: New regulations will allow environmental clearance for non-coal mining projects up to 500 hectares at the state level. This decision is expected to further decentralise the environment clearance process for these projects. State Environment Impact Assessment Authorities will be responsible for granting the clearances, enhancing efficiency. The change follows a draft notification issued earlier this year, highlighting the experience of state bodies.

items.title: Shree Cement targets 100 MT capacity in 3-4 years on India growth bet
items.summary: Shree Cement plans to expand its production capacity to over 100 million tonnes per annum within four years. The company aims for a growth rate of 9-10 percent, surpassing the industry average. They have announced significant investments in new plants across various states in India to support this expansion. Shree Cement is also growing its ready-mix concrete operations, planning to increase capacity significantly.

items.title: PNB needs Rs 5,000 crore extra provisions under ECL, CEO sees limited impact
items.summary: Punjab National Bank expects an additional provision of approximately Rs 5,000 crore due to ECL migration. They initially estimated higher but reduced the expected requirement based on digital assessments. The bank has created dedicated platforms for credit cards, supply chain management, and cash management services. These initiatives are expected to enhance the bank's non-interest income during challenging times.

items.title: Government, corporate spending to sustain global growth in 2027 as inflation eases: JPMorgan
items.summary: Global economic growth is projected to be resilient in 2027 due to continued government investment and corporate spending. Investment in technology and recovery in consumer demand are expected to drive this growth forward. Corporate investment, especially in artificial intelligence, is noteworthy, with major firms planning significant expenditure. Inflation pressures are anticipated to ease, strengthening household spending. However, rising government borrowing and competition for capital may pose challenges for financial markets.
